label: Blind sample 111: Hansen forest loss 2019, tile 00N_060W

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.04 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2019 (90% interval −0.07 to +0.05). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 10 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.18). Counted by gap size instead, 2 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.05). But: only 18 clear observation periods before the event (need 20).
reasons: only 18 clear observation periods before the event (need 20)

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar passes every test on its own: radar backscatter (VH) −0.5 dB, interval −0.9 to −0.3.
